meaning: Finite spot footprints assign fractions of each assay count vector to registered cell masks. Outside footprint area remains unassigned, without renormalization.
spatial: C1 and C2 are adjacent and non-overlapping
S2 overlaps both C1 and C2 and, by chosen schematic geometry, no outside area
S4 overlaps C2 and outside all masks
S5 lies wholly outside all masks
featureMeaning: x_i = (x_i1, …, x_iF) is the entire count vector at spot i. Feature index f is distinct from spot index i. F is unspecified.
requiredDefinitions: schematic geometry; α and β are symbolic, not measured values

design.neutral: formula text, spot labels, operators, separators
design.layout: large spatial field upper left; aligned cell-by-spot matrix upper right; two explicit symbolic output vector sums at bottom

relationshipPlan.marks: disk = one spot footprint; cell contour = one mask; matrix cell = area fraction; x-index label = whole feature vector; vector components use f or F
relationshipPlan.identity: S1–S5 spatial labels repeat as matrix columns and pair with x₁–x₅; C1/C2 colors and labels repeat in matrix rows and output labels
relationshipPlan.edges: single arrow from visible spatial domain frame to visible assignment matrix frame means footprint-to-weight derivation; aggregation is expressed by exact equations rather than a fabricated flow module
relationshipPlan.unknowns: No count values or feature dimension. α and β remain symbolic even though placement is schematic.
relationshipPlan.centralRelationship: One disk can split its vector between cells or leave part unassigned, and cell vectors sum only the assigned portions.

sourceReferenceStudy.observation: CLIP uses indexed top/left axes to make pairwise identity traceable. Adopt explicit matrix axes, not its encoders, photos, triangular modules or training/application panel structure.
